frames.heading: Mars
frames.body: On the red planet Mars, a funky dance party is about to begin! The sun shines down on the rocky landscape, filling the air with a warm glow. Martians gather in a big open area, their eyes sparkling with excitement as they get ready for some live music. Mojo hops onto the stage, brimming with energy, eager to mix his lively Earth beats with the Martians' unique style. With a big smile, he's ready to turn Mars into a dance floor, showing that no matter where you are in the universe, everyone can groove together!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Mars! Now this is what I call a cool vibe. Red rocks and dusty skies - let's see if you're ready to get funky!

frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: Welcome, Mojo. We are... intrigued by your rhythm. Martians move differently. Our dance is slow and deliberate. Can we... adapt?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Zarvox, every planet's got its own rhythm! We'll mix your slow groove with my funky beats, and we'll create something out of this world!

frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: We are ready to learn. Martian rhythm has never encountered... Earth funk.

frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: We will synchronize with your rhythm. Begin when ready.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: That's what I like to hear! Get ready, 'cause the funk train is about to roll into Mars!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Alright, we've got a funky new challenge here on Mars. It's not just about hitting the right moves anymore - sometimes we've got to hold back.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: When a beat shows up that looks red, that's our cue to hold back. Don't make the gesture for that one, we let it slide by.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: And we've got a brand-new symbol to work with - the index finger pointing up! Raise that finger and hold it proud when it shows up.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Stay smooth, dodge the bad beats, and let's mix Earth funk with Martian style!
